sentences.japanese: 君は潔く辞任すべきだ。
sentences.english: You should do the honorable thing and resign.

sentences.japanese: それが私の間違いであったことを私は潔く認める。
sentences.english: I'm ready to admit that it was my fault.

sentences.japanese: その兵士は丸腰の兵士を撃つことを潔しとしなかった。
sentences.english: The soldier disdained shooting an unarmed enemy.

sentences.japanese: 出処進退の潔さをわきまえている、と彼は言っているけれど、いざとなったらどうだかね。
sentences.english: He always talks as though he knows how to handle himself but you never know how he'll act when the chips are down.
